tips.title: Rounds
tips.text: Each round you act first: every tower may use each of its ready abilities. Click End Turn (or press {key:EndRound}) and the enemies move and attack; then new enemies may arrive and the next round starts.

tips.title: Placing towers
tips.text: Towers cost energy. Click a card in your hand at the bottom, then a tile: the tiles you can build on light up. Some levels give energy each round, and selling a tower gives some of its cost back.

tips.title: Cooldowns
tips.text: A number after an ability's name is how many turns it must wait before it can be used again. An ability without one is ready every turn.

tips.title: Walking
tips.text: Towers can walk: pick their walk ability, then a tile. Enemies keep to their roads, and towers never stand on a road.

tips.title: Quick cast
tips.text: {click:QuickCast} an ability on the tower panel to use it at once: the tower picks the target by itself, the way it would if nobody aimed it.

tips.title: Statuses
tips.text: The small icons over a unit are its statuses: green ones help, red ones harm. Point at them to see what they do and how long they last.

tips.title: Taunt
tips.text: A taunted enemy goes for the tower that taunted it whenever it can reach it. Use it to keep enemies away from your base and your weaker towers.

tips.title: Bosses
tips.text: Bosses are much tougher than other enemies. Some abilities hurt them more: the Priest's Smite hits a boss three times as hard.

tips.title: Losing a level
tips.text: When an enemy destroys your base, the level is lost. You keep every tower you own; Retry and try another plan.

tips.title: The camera
tips.text: Drag the map with the mouse (hold the left or middle button and move), zoom with the mouse wheel, and rotate it with {key:RotateLeft} and {key:RotateRight}. {key:CameraUp} {key:CameraLeft} {key:CameraDown} {key:CameraRight} or pushing the pointer to the edge of the screen move it too.

tips.title: Keys
tips.text: Every key can be changed in Settings > Controls. A key given to two actions shows in red there.
